purpose: Non-windowed verification of Rust workspace swipe state and preview placement; GUI acceptance deferred by user
verified_mechanisms: Rust owns the opt-in workspace swipe gesture state: accumulated deltas, 12-point threshold, horizontal dominance/vertical lock, current position, 0.22-page edge rubber band, nearest target and gesture lifecycle.

Finger-up, first momentum event and phase-less idle completion close tracking. Trailing inertia does not apply additional movement. Explicit begin or a new phase-less gesture re-arms state; cancellation stops tracking without committing a browser command.
Rust returns neighboring preview indices and fractional horizontal translations, bounded to three pages. Native compositor layers consume the plan. Workspace IDs and WebContents remain outside Rust.

The C++ bridge retains the previous Views gesture policy. WorkspaceShell retains visibility/dialog/configuration guards, platform phase decoding, native timers, source/destination validation and application commit callbacks.

Six new unit cases cover reversal, multi-space skipping, stationary-cursor rearming, axis thresholds/lock, one-shot momentum finish, closed streams, phase-less completion, both edge limits, preview bounds/rounding and malformed numeric input.
deferred_checkpoint: Run the complete Metal and Views browser matrices on these rebuilt sources. Include SidebarSwipeTracksCancelsAndSkipsSpaces, CocoaSwipesRepeatWithoutMouseMovement, SidebarRemainsOpenWhileSpacesSlide and MetalReturnsAfterWorkspaceAnimation.

Package/sign the matching build and inspect isolated-profile gestures, vertical scrolling, repeated gestures, cancellation/hide, workspace changes while committing, reduced motion, Unicode previews and restoration of Metal after settle.
Run broader physical input/IME/accessibility/RTL/scale coverage and controlled CPU/GPU/actual presentation measurements.
limitations: Compilation and non-windowed unit tests do not establish native event integration, visual correctness, focus behavior, frame presentation or a performance gain.
Preview paint records, snapshot rasterization, compositor animation and timers remain native. This stage does not remove Views from workspace transitions.
The old 43 Metal / 17 Views GUI results are historical evidence only; no new windowed tests or app launch were performed.
No new dependency, crate or framework was introduced. Original-code Apache-2.0 and required upstream notices are unchanged.
build_consistency: final Ninja dry run reported no work to do
